components.note: The composition proof is written. The prenex step introduces no nonlogical symbol and takes fresh binders from a fixed infinite variable enumeration (ANX 110-119; table step 2 at SUP 144-147; R 125-126). The Skolem step introduces one fresh function symbol per existential position, a constant for an initial existential, and signature L* (ANX 121-133; R 290-301). The CNF/Cl step stays in L*, introduces no symbol or variable and is not a Tseitin step (ANX 135-140; SUP 96-100). The closure step is proved in both directions using the nonempty domain (ANX 142-163).

Equisatisfiability under AC is stated with the forward direction as model expansion (AC) and the reverse as reduct (no choice) (SUP 118-121, R 320-328) and proved (ANX 165-171). Only the Skolem step weakens equivalence (SUP 123-124, 154-155, figure caption 203-206). Formula equivalence across Skolemization is explicitly disclaimed (ANX 173-174; R 432-435). The NNF, rectification, prenex and CNF steps are stated as equivalences and the closure step as having the same models.
